description.zh:
新资源组ID。
关于资源组的更多信息，请参见[什么是资源组](~~94475~~)。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which you want to move the resource. For more information about resource groups, see the "Resource Group" section of the [What is Resource Management?](~~94475~~) topic.

description.zh:
资源所属的地域ID。  
您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~131035~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the resource.
You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
资源类型，取值：  

- stack：资源栈。  

- stackgroup：资源栈组。  

- template：模板。

- templatescratch：资源场景。
description.en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

- stack: stack

- stackgroup: stack group

- template: template

title.zh: 修改资源所属的资源组

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，在杭州地域`cn-hangzhou`将资源栈`4e8611cb-251e-42b7-b9cb-3496362c****`添加到资源组`rg-acfm3peow3k****`中。
descriptions.en: In this example, a stack deployed in the `China (Hangzhou)` region is moved to a specific resource group. The ID of the stack is `4e8611cb-251e-42b7-b9cb-3496362c****` and the ID of the resource group is `rg-acfm3peow3k****`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros move-resource-group --resource-type stack --resource-id 4e8611cb-251e-42b7-b9cb-3496362c0000 --new-resource-group-id rg-acfm3peow3k0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
